replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
Hello!

We appreciate your report, however this is actually an incident where a player model is several blocks off its actual position. This is caused by lag and/or other factors.
Since you shot Samir_14 in the opposite direction of the bridge, he did not fall off.

Happy New Year, and keep up the reports!
